snippet: if (min === null || v < min) min = v;
reason: Equivalent, and checked rather than argued. The mutant also reassigns min when v equals the current min, i.e. it replaces a BigInt with an equal BigInt, so the minimum it ends on is the same value. Verified by differential run: 200,000 random lists of 1-9 BigInt values drawn from 0-7 (many ties): the original and mutated loops end on the identical minimum every time.

reason: Equivalent, and checked rather than argued.
